# Phase 7 implementation report

Status: blocked evidence candidate; Build Manager exact-head review remains
required. Base was the accepted Phase 6 revision
`81c33493881a039923b9a6a94263b05578bfdce7`. Runtime implementation commits are
`46342a9c0d88e5fe1ec762910221d6dc3ad63d97`,
`121a4c34f46f1969b5d555be1f7727766bddfe7e`, and
`0448f004c15122dda0eb29e04ec6830942032d0c`.

This phase made no remote publication, merge, deployment, issue-tracker

change, or active Twinzy/Triforge operation.

## Ticket status

- **F7-01 — blocked:** the public flow can now import an approval-bound
  starter, create an exact local product repository, prepare a real Console work
  item, execute a provider, project evidence, and recover the Console after a
  stale owner. The first functional result passed the frozen contract but
  violated ambient-context and dependency-portability constraints. The single
  separately authorized bounded rerun passed restart and no-symlink checks, but
  substituted a hand-written compatibility package after the genuine offline
  dependency was unavailable and did not establish absence of every
  outside-path read. Its own substituted harness reported pass; an independent
  rerun with genuine Playwright failed the frozen final delete-after-restart
  assertion (`1 !== 0`). It was not retried.
- **F7-02 — blocked by unavailable host evidence:** the pinned macOS Node path,
  Python runtime, frozen checksums/starting states, full repository gate, and
  packed CLI were observed. No independent Linux instance or WSL2 host exists
  in the available environment. A fresh Python product was provisioned, but the
  public preparation command correctly rejected its inherited isolated profile
  before provider execution. That is a configuration gate, not a solved case.
- **F7-03 — blocked by work/authority:** a live read-only Jira query found no
  eligible small, ready, unclaimed Twinzy item. The available issues are epics,
  blocked by a security-boundary migration, part of active Triforge delivery,
  or themselves a large migration. Authority to create a new proof ticket was
  not granted and was not inferred. All-provider contribution and verified
  deployment therefore remain unproved.
- **F7-04 — blocked by prerequisites:** frozen inputs were reverified and a
  candid dimensional report was written, but no isolated Triforge comparison
  resource/run exists and F7-01 through F7-03 are incomplete. No comparison or
  release claim is fabricated.

## Delivered product repairs

`46342a9` adds approval-bound, race-resistant local source import, exact-root
Git bootstrap, and the public `faktori console prepare` path. `121a4c3` adds
exact coordinator process identity/reclaim rules and a bounded native Codex
configuration that suppresses ambient user config, rules, memory, optional
integrations, fanout, and approval escalation. The native mode is candidly not
a filesystem read-isolation boundary.

The manager's whole-plan audit also found that the accepted V1 specification
promised executable `faktori product new` behavior while the package exposed
only a read-only preview. The candidate now uses the existing discovery,
proposal, exact approval, and provisioning journal primitives to add exactly
one approved product to an existing factory. The add-product proposal preserves
factory defaults, providers, environments, existing products/repositories, and
all pods; it records incremental cost/workload, makes an exclusive append-only
claim on the previous approved configuration revision, creates only the named
product repository, and never creates a pod. The public CLI journey prepares
the new product through the real Console consumer, adds a second product from
the resulting revision, replays safely, and exercises a competing-addition
loser that stops before repository creation.

## Observed verification

- all 20 frozen fixture checksum entries passed;
- individual macOS starting-state checks reproduced task-board RED, due-date
  base GREEN, due-date feature RED, and Python boundary RED as documented;
- the final pinned implementation gate passed strict typecheck, 39 test files /
  311 tests, Console and TypeScript builds, and clean packed-CLI verification
  on Node 24.20.0/npm 12.0.2; the captured exit-0 summary is
  `docs/build/evidence/phase-7-final-check.txt`;
- focused source-import tests cover pre-apply and mid-copy mutation, symlinks,
  exclusive destinations, and parent Git repositories;
- focused Console tests cover dead, reused, and unknown coordinator ownership;
  the Build Manager independently observed the corrected Console suite pass;
  and
- an unmodified-CLI, no-inference prompt diagnostic accepted the bounded flags
  and emitted no memory marker.
- the final product-add focused gate passed 3 files / 27 tests, including the
  true exclusive-write race and repository-import resumption. The Build Manager
  independently passed the preceding 3-file / 25-test consumer journey before
  the final race correction.
- the Attempt 3 product's own 1/1 output is classified untrusted because its
  Playwright package was substituted. A separate genuine-Playwright execution
  of the unchanged frozen contract failed at delete-after-restart, proving the
  product does not satisfy the behavioral contract; the exit-1 evidence is
  `docs/build/evidence/phase-7-attempt3-trusted-contract.txt`.

The macOS Docker client had no usable server, and no Podman, Colima, Lima,
Multipass, OrbStack, QEMU, or WSL path was available. Linux and WSL2 remain
unverified rather than inferred.

## Construction accounting and release boundary

Phase 7 used one Terra-medium cold-start specialist, one Luna-medium host/fixture
specialist, and a Sol-high implementer/orchestrator. Specialist counters and
parent/child overlap are unavailable and remain unknown. The Phase 7 planning
estimate was revised from 600,000 to 850,000 and then 1,300,000 after observed
assembly/security rework, the one invalid bounded rerun, and the missing
product-new path; it is advisory and does not cap the active goal or weaken the
fixed acceptance criteria. Final root telemetry is an overlap-safe lower bound
of 1,230,468 tokens (94.65% of the revised estimate); specialist counters,
manager attribution, and parent/child overlap remain unknown. Account capacity
was observed separately at 97% used / 3% remaining, with no paid credits and
both reset credits unused.

## Concrete next prerequisites

Before another F7-01 attempt, resolve the benchmark's test-tool setup gap:
the frozen task-board manifest declares no Playwright dependency even though
its browser contract imports Playwright. The factory repository pins the
genuine harness at 1.63.0 through its lockfile; 1.55.0 was the worker's choice,
not an accepted product requirement. Preserve the frozen fixtures and failed
results. Define and record a reproducible trusted harness installation and
browser preflight, equally available to both comparison systems, before any
new run. Do not let workers replace the harness or infer a successful install
from a manifest or lockfile alone. If making the fixture self-contained changes
its frozen inputs, version it and explicitly identify the new comparison;
never silently amend the old rubric. This preparation has not been proved in
a clean-room run. A future
scope proof must also use the validated isolated profile or equivalent observed
file-access evidence; a host-home path in the journal is an evidence gap, not by
itself proof that the provider read that path.

F7-02 next requires an independent Linux instance for both Node and Python (and
a real WSL2 host when available). F7-03 requires an eligible small ready
unclaimed Twinzy item or explicit authority to create a bounded proof item,
plus approved deployment/test resources and all three providers. F7-04 requires
an isolated Triforge fixture runner under the frozen equal conditions. None of
those resources or authorities is inferred by this report.

Faktori V1 is not complete while the compliant fresh run, independent Linux
path, all-provider isolated Twinzy deployment, paired frozen comparison, and
Build Manager exact-head acceptance remain unresolved. The candidate preserves
each prerequisite and first exact blocking gate instead of converting partial
runtime success into release acceptance.

- `bb576ad` revises the full-phase advisory forecast to 4,200,000 tokens. The

Linux Python reproduced its expected baseline in a constrained container. The
Linux Node frozen envelope also passes after an environment-only repair assigned

audit found no approved isolated fixture resource. The owner-selected local
TWZ-83 comparison has not launched:
host-native Codex, Claude and Cursor processes require direct informed approval
because they are not an OS filesystem-isolation boundary. No Jira mutation,
push, merge, deployment, staging write, provider execution, reset or paid route
occurred in this continuation.

Consequently F7-01 through F7-04 remain blocked and V1 remains incomplete.
